4bdb0b1a95ba4053.description: Job description About Us Soum is on a mission to revolutionize e-commerce in the MENA region and beyond by building the most convenient and trustworthy re-commerce marketplace in the region. We're reshaping how C2C marketplaces operate, making buying and selling second-hand products seamless and reliable. Since our launch in July 2021, Soum has become one of the fastest-growing startups in the region, achieving rapid expansion in both our team and product offerings. In recognition of our impact and growth, we were proudly named one of the Top 10 LinkedIn Startups in Saudi Arabia for 2024. Role Overview Soum's car showroom is where customers meet the brand face to face. The After-Sales Specialist owns the customer experience from the moment a sale is signed through handover and beyond. The goal is to ensure every customer leaves confident in their purchase, any issue is resolved quickly, and buyers become repeat customers who recommend Soum. This is an urgent hiring opportunity. Candidates who can join within two weeks or less may be prioritized during the selection process. However, candidates with longer notice periods are still welcome to apply and will be considered. Duties & Responsibilities Vehicle Handover Prepare each car for handover, making sure it is clean and complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Paperwork & Procedures Follow up on ownership transfer via Absher and the Traffic Department, and on insurance issuance with the relevant parties. Follow up on financing and instalments with finance providers when needed. Ensure contracts and invoices are complete and archived in the system. Warranty & Complaints Receive post-sale warranty requests and complaints, log them, and follow up until closed. Coordinate with approved maintenance workshops and the inspection team to resolve technical issues. Escalate complex cases to the Showroom Manager in line with approved procedures. Follow-Up & Customer Loyalty Contact every customer after their order is completed and the car is received, to confirm the car arrived in the agreed condition, that they have faced no technical, paperwork, or missing-accessory issues since handover, and whether they need further service or support. Schedule regular follow-up calls, for example within 3 days and again 30 days after handover. Open a ticket immediately for any issue the customer raises, follow it through to resolution, then check back to confirm they are satisfied. Log the outcome of every follow-up call and all customer data accurately in the CRM system. Offer relevant add-on services such as protection, window tinting, maintenance packages, and insurance. Gather customer feedback and submit a monthly report on recurring issues and improvement suggestions. Qualifications & Requirements Saudi nationals only. High school diploma at minimum. A diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. At least 2 years of experience in after-sales or customer service at car showrooms or dealerships. Valid Saudi driving licence. Knowledge of ownership transfer, insurance, and financing procedures in Saudi Arabia. Fluent in Arabic and good English. Nice to Have Previous experience in the used car market. Hands-on experience with CRM systems. Basic technical knowledge of car parts and inspection reports. Skills & Competencies Strong communication skills and a courteous manner with customers. Calm and patient when handling complaints and upset customers. Accurate and organised in tracking documents and appointments. Able to solve problems and make decisions within their authority. Skilled at upselling without pressuring the customer. Proficient in basic computer tools, including Excel, email, and internal systems. A team player who coordinates well with Sales, Inspection, and Maintenance Key Performance Indicators Post-handover customer satisfaction (CSAT): 90% or higher. Net Promoter Score (NPS): 50 or higher. First response time to complaints: within 24 hours. Complaint resolution rate: 90% within 7 days. Ownership transfer completion: within 3 working days of sale. Follow-up calls completed: 100% of customers. Add-on service sales: 20% of deals. CRM customer data accuracy: 95% or higher. Benefits Competitive salary plus commission on add-on services. Medical insurance. A fast-growing Saudi tech company. Training and career growth opportunities. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

4bf3d0e19cd0e3a6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لاين للتغليف عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية، من إعداد المستندات وتوثيق الإيرادات إلى تدقيق الحسابات المصرفية وإعداد التقارير المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية وفقاً للموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمتابعة وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل تقع في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق مالي يدعم العمليات التشغيلية لشركة لاين للتغليف. نظرة عامة على الدور يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية شاملة في إدارة الجوانب المالية، بما في ذلك إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها، إعداد القيود المحاسبية، تسجيل العمليات المالية، تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وحفظ التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة لاين للتغليف، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

4b23357fd79d21cd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال لأعلى المعايير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة وإصلاح المعدات بهدف تقليل العوادم والمخلفات، والتأكد من سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة البيئية. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفتيشية منتظمة لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات لضمان الالتزام بمعايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الشأن. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية الحديثة في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، مع فهم عميق لمعايير الصناعة وتطبيقاتها في المشاريع الهندسية. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة بدوام كامل في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق ملتزم بضمان أعلى معايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين وذوي الخبرة للتقديم لهذا الدور في ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات.

4b79e2b8b7b5d526.description: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based. What this opportunity involves We re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may: Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor trap answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems; Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality; Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales; Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You re improving the AI tools you ll eventually use yourself. If you re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us! Project time expectations For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted. Desired Candidate Profile What we look for This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have: Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board); Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred); Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine); Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines; Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus); Strong written English (C1+). This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

In this role, your primary focus will be engaging directly with end-user business operators, including restaurants, hotels, cafes, and catering companies, to understand their culinary setup needs and facilitate direct sales. Strong experience in the hospitality equipment sector is essential for success in this position. Key Responsibilities • Direct Foodservice & Venue Sales (Primary Focus): Drive direct sales of commercial kitchen equipment, refrigeration, stainless steel fabrication, and dishwashing systems to restaurant owners, hotel F&B managers, cafe operators, and commercial caterers. • Field Prospecting & Pipeline Building: Identify new venue openings and active fit-outs through cold calls, site visits, and relationships with local chefs, restaurant managers, and hospitality entrepreneurs. • Site Consulting & Proposals: Review kitchen space layouts, interpret technical requirements (including 60Hz KSA electrical standards), and prepare professional Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and commercial proposals directly for business owners. • Corporate & MEP Alignment (Plus): Collaborate with MEP contractors, engineering consultants, and corporate project managers on larger developments that require institutional bidding. • Closing & Sales Targets: Lead price negotiations and contract signing to consistently achieve monthly and annual revenue goals. Key Requirements & Qualifications • Experience: 3-5 years of proven sales experience in commercial kitchen or hospitality equipment in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh market experience preferred), with a strong track record of selling directly to restaurant and hotel operators. • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of commercial kitchen gear, layout blueprints, and utility connections (electrical & plumbing integration). • Mandatory Qualifications: • Status: Valid, Transferable Iqama (currently residing in KSA for immediate hire). • Licensing: Valid Saudi Driver’s License. • Languages: Fluent English is required. Business Arabic is a strong advantage for direct client relations; knowledge of Urdu/Hindi is beneficial for site and back-of-house coordination. • Education: High School Diploma / College Diploma or equivalent (Technical/Engineering background is a plus). What We Offer • Competitive base salary with an attractive performance-driven commission structure. • Company support for business transportation/allowance. • Dynamic work environment with clear career advancement opportunities. Skills • Experience: 3-5 years of proven sales experience in commercial kitchen or hospitality equipment in Saudi Arabia (Riyadh market experience preferred), with a strong track record of selling directly to restaurant and hotel operators. • Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of commercial kitchen gear, layout blueprints, and utility connections (electrical & plumbing integration).

4bcedd5ec96f4e04.job_title: Senior Full Stack Programmer - IT | Saudi Arabia Senior Full stack Programmer - IT | Saudi Arabia
4bcedd5ec96f4e04.description: Join a leading Saudi technology and systems integration company specializing in delivering innovative enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, networking, and digital transformation solutions to government, enterprise, and commercial customers across the Kingdom. The Senior Full Stack Programmer will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments. The role requires a highly experienced software professional capable of developing scalable applications, troubleshooting complex technical issues, integrating enterprise systems, supporting production environments, and providing technical guidance in a fast-paced technology solutions environment. Key Accountabilities: Design, develop, implement, and maintain high-performance enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments. Develop modern and responsive front-end applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly . Develop and maintain back-end applications, services, and APIs using C# and .NET Core 9+ . Utilize Entity Framework, ORM technologies, and appropriate Design Patterns to develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality applications. Design, develop, optimize, and maintain databases using SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB . Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and application services to support enterprise systems and business requirements. Implement application security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure coding practices . Deploy, manage, and support applications using Docker and Kubernetes . Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes. Monitor application performance, identify potential issues, and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production incidents . Plan and execute application upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and deployments while minimizing operational disruption. Coordinate with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, database, and application teams to ensure effective application delivery and issue resolution. Support application testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production operations , ensuring timely resolution of technical issues. Maintain accurate application architecture documentation, source code, configurations, API documentation, deployment procedures, and operating guidelines . Ensure applications can be developed, deployed, and maintained effectively within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments . Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to junior developers and technical team members to enhance team capabilities and development standards. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field. Minimum 5–7 years of experience in full-stack software development, preferably within a large-scale technology, enterprise, government, or systems integration environment. Strong hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly . Solid experience with C#, .NET Core 9+, Entity Framework, ORM frameworks, and software Design Patterns . Strong experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL, and database management . Hands-on experience with Telerik, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines . Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, application integration, authentication, authorization, application security, and performance optimization . Strong understanding of software architecture, development best practices, scalability, maintainability, and application performance . Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production issues . Experience with application deployment, upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and production support . Experience working within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments . Strong experience coordinating with cross-functional technical teams, project stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and database teams . Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work effectively under pressure. Experience providing technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and team members is an advantage.

4b18b76d5293faf0.description: Job description Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money. The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores. Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region. Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion. About the role Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L. This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant. What you will be doing The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow. The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved. Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it. Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why. Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build. What you will need Saudi Arabia residency, familiarity with the market and an understanding of local culture 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager. Experience with credit or lending products matters most, but strong experience in fin-tech or tech products also works A proven track record of managing complex product lifecycles and delivering successful products Attention to detail, our products work with people's money, so precision matters at every step Comfort working with risk, compliance and legal to get a product approved, not just designed Resilience and the ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment Fluency in English and Arabic Benefits What you can expect Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one. Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters. Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance. Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory. Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs. We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be). If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

4b2c7f3778a64cb4.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الصحة والسلامة الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان وتقديم مجموعة واسعة من المعالجات السنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع حالة كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير الممارسات المهنية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستمرار لمواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. إدارة الوثائق والتقارير إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان. حفظ هذه الوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق مركز الصحة والسلامة الطبي في المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى.

Carrier emphasizes diversity and inclusion and aims to deliver client-centric solutions. Role Overview Carrier is seeking a Sales Engineer - BMS to join its team in Riyadh. This is a permanent position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The primary purpose of this role is to identify and develop business opportunities for Building Management Systems (BMS) solutions, promote building automation products, and manage the sales process from proposal to project closure. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop business opportunities for BMS solutions. Promote building automation products and systems to consultants, contractors, and end-users. Prepare technical and commercial proposals. Negotiate and close projects. Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and consultants, ensuring customer satisfaction. Scan for current business opportunities within the assigned territory. Provide technical support throughout the sales process. Achieve established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Approach customers to drive revenue through a professional sales process. Understand customer needs and build trust. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field. Compensation and Benefits Carrier offers development opportunities, a competitive salary, and a benefits package for this permanent role.

4bbca5905326c7f3.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Procurement Director to lead procurement operations across our residential projects portfolio. This leadership role requires strategic oversight of procurement activities, focusing on delivering high-quality materials and services while optimizing cost and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and manage procurement strategies aligned with the company’s residential project goals. Oversee procurement planning, sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier relationship management. Collaborate closely with project teams and other departments to forecast procurement needs and ensure timely delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and maximize value. Maintain compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies, including sustainability and local content requirements. Lead and mentor the procurement team to achieve operational excellence and foster professional growth. Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and industry innovations to capitalize on new opportunities. Prepare and present procurement reports and metrics for senior management and stakeholders. Promote ethical sourcing and corporate social responsibility throughout procurement activities. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related disciplines; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum 10-15 years of progressive procurement experience, preferably in large-scale residential construction or real estate projects. Demonstrated expertise in procurement strategy development and execution. Strong negotiation skills and experience managing complex supplier contracts. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. Proficiency with procurement software and data analytics tools. Knowledge of local content regulations and sustainability initiatives is a plus. Fluent in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.

4b01bceb67654980.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز العمران المتقدم للاستشارات الهندسية عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الدعم الإداري. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنسيق وتنظيم المهام الإدارية المختلفة بكفاءة عالية. ربط وتنسيق المهام بين الأقسام المختلفة لضمان التكامل. إعداد التقارير والمستندات باستخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس. دعم الفريق الإداري في المهام اليومية لضمان سلاسة العمليات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التنسيق والتنظيم الإداري. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التنسيق والتنظيم الإداري. إتقان استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحت الضغط. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة وقت قوية. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز العمران المتقدم للاستشارات الهندسية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

4b292f71e4a37083.job_title: Regional Sales Manager Al Futtaim Automotive FAMCO
4b292f71e4a37083.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking an experienced Regional Sales Manager for Al-Futtaim Automotive, specifically for FAMCO Riyadh. This full-time position is based in Dammam and reports directly to the Country Manager – FAMCO KSA. The role focuses on leading the Trucks & Buses sales business across Saudi Arabia, with a primary objective to drive sales volume, revenue, and gross margin. Role Context and Objectives The Regional Sales Manager will be instrumental in setting the sales direction for the Trucks & Buses division. A key aspect of this role involves strengthening forecasting accuracy and ensuring consistent commercial performance across the business. The successful candidate will lead a high-performing regional sales structure, overseeing operations in key cities including Dammam, Riyadh, and Jeddah. Key Responsibilities Lead the national sales function for Trucks & Buses to achieve agreed sales, revenue, and gross margin targets. Manage and coach regional sales managers across Riyadh, Dammam, and Jeddah to ensure strong commercial results. Collaborate with Planning and Analysis teams to establish monthly and quarterly sales objectives by model and branch. Develop and maintain a robust forecasting process, providing accurate weekly sales and margin updates to senior leadership. Monitor sales progression daily, weekly, and monthly, implementing timely actions to keep performance on track. Maximize stock availability and support sales campaigns designed to manage overage inventory effectively. Build and maintain KPI reporting that offers clear insight into market performance and sales trends. Collaborate with retail partners and internal stakeholders to ensure sales campaigns are relevant, targeted, and capable of delivering results. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant sales leadership role. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage regional sales teams. Proven track record in driving sales volume, revenue, and gross margin. Work Location This position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending across Riyadh and Jeddah. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

4b8bd6d5e67485d9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بن عميرة للمقاولات عن سكرتير للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمدير أو الإدارة من خلال تنظيم المهام المكتبية اليومية، وإدارة الاتصالات، والمساعدة في تنسيق المشاريع الأساسية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدوين الملاحظات بطريقة الاختزال (الكتابة السريعة) ونسخ المراسلات والتقارير ومحاضر الاجتماعات، مع مراجعتها وتنسيقها وفقاً لمعايير المكتب. تلقي المكالمات الهاتفية وفرزها وتوجيهها، واستلام الرسائل الهاتفية، والإجابة على استفسارات المتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الشخص المناسب. التعامل مع البريد الوارد والصادر، وفحص المراسلات البريدية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها. فحص طلبات الاجتماعات والمواعيد، وتنسيق جداول المشاركين، وتحديد أوقات الاجتماعات، وتأمين قاعة الاجتماعات، وتحضير جدول الأعمال. إنشاء أنظمة لحفظ الملفات والسجلات وصيانتها، وحفظ جميع المستندات بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية أو الدعم الإداري. القدرة على كتابة الوثائق وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية والتعامل مع الزوار بمهنية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة وقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق داعم في شركة بن عميرة للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4ba3072b13d35ec7.description: About TechnipFMC and the Role TechnipFMC is dedicated to driving change within the energy industry, focusing on building a sustainable future through innovation and global collaboration. We are seeking an HR Advisor to join our team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role supports the People & Culture agenda by establishing and maintaining effective policy, process, and governance practices. Key Responsibilities Provide daily People & Culture support to managers and employees, ensuring advice is timely, practical, policy-aligned, and consistent with employment requirements. Advise on the interpretation and application of employment policies, procedures, and practices, including matters related to conduct, capability, absence, performance, and employee concerns. Coach and guide managers to effectively address people matters, take ownership of people management responsibilities, and apply fair, consistent, and timely decision-making. Support the development, review, and implementation of People & Culture policies, processes, and local procedures, ensuring alignment with business needs, corporate standards, and governance requirements. Monitor the effectiveness of People & Culture processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, compliance, employee experience, and manager self-sufficiency. Maintain awareness of short, medium, and long-term business requirements and translate these into practical People & Culture actions that support operational priorities. Support disciplinary, grievance, capability, and performance-related cases by providing guidance on process, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and appropriate escalation. Contribute to corporate and local People & Culture projects, supporting planning, communication, implementation, change adoption, and follow-up actions. Coordinate with Global Mobility and relevant stakeholders regarding international assignments, ensuring employees and managers receive appropriate guidance in line with applicable policies. Work closely with Shared Services to ensure employee lifecycle activities, records, documentation, and transactions are processed accurately, efficiently, and within required timelines. Promote best practice, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability across People & Culture activities, encouraging managers and employees to engage positively with the people agenda. Required Qualifications and Experience Formal Education: A recognized certificate in Business Administration is required. Work experience can compensate for a lack of formal education. Experience: Proven experience in an HR function with exposure to the full employee life cycle. Global organizational exposure is preferred. Certifications: CIPD Level 5 certificate is not essential but beneficial. Skills and Abilities Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to build trust, handle sensitive matters confidentially, influence managers, and support employees professionally and objectively across a multi-cultural environment. Technical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess symptoms, contribute to identifying root causes, and recommend appropriate solutions. Good attention to detail in HR documentation, case management, and employee records. Confident using HR systems, Microsoft Office tools, and reporting data to support HR activities. Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on actions within required timelines. Ability to interpret policies and apply them consistently to practical people matters. Work Environment This role is based in Dhahran, Eastern, and is a full-time position. You will join a global team of over 21,000 people, contributing to a culture that values curiosity, expertise, ideas, equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity.

4ba5dc023ee3b160.description: About St. Regis Hotels & Resorts St. Regis Hotels & Resorts combines timeless glamour with a vanguard spirit, offering exquisite experiences in over 50 luxury hotels and resorts globally. The brand, which originated with John Jacob Astor IV's St. Regis hotel in New York, maintains a commitment to an unconditional level of service that anticipates guest needs. This service is delivered seamlessly by a team of hosts who blend classic sophistication with modern sensibility, complemented by exclusive butler service. St. Regis is part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands. The Executive Event Sales Role This full-time Executive Event Sales position is based in the Red Sea region. The role involves utilizing sales techniques to optimize revenue while maintaining guest loyalty, processing reservations and requests, and supporting sales and marketing functions. The successful candidate will contribute to promoting brand image and ensuring high standards of guest service. Key Responsibilities Contact relevant departments (*, Sales, Data Administration, Accounting) to resolve guest inquiries or issues. Implement sales techniques to maximize revenue while preserving guest loyalty, including upselling. Process all room reservations, changes, and cancellations received via phone, fax, or mail. Enter Marriott Rewards program information accurately when taking guest reservations. Attend to, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns. Perform general office duties to support Sales and Marketing, such as filing, emailing, and transcribing information. Assist management in training and motivating employees, serving as a role model. Comply with company policies and procedures, maintain a professional appearance, ensure confidentiality, and protect company assets. Acknowledge and receive guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally, prepare accurate written documents, and answer telephones using proper protocol. Cultivate positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Monitor performance to ensure expectations and quality standards are met. Read and visually verify information in various formats. Lift and move objects weighing 10 pounds or less without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Experience Education: A high school diploma or equivalent General Educational Development (GED) certificate is required. Experience: A minimum of 2 years of related work experience is necessary for this role. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required. Work Environment and Company Culture Marriott International is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive environment where the diversity of associates' backgrounds is valued. The company does not discriminate based on disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Joining St. Regis means becoming part of a global team within Marriott International, where associates are encouraged to perform their best work and fulfill their purpose.

4bc4ca89d3b02f09.description: About Alfa Laval Alfa Laval is a global company focused on engineering innovation to contribute to a more sustainable future. The company designs and implements refining, recycling, and purifying processes for various applications, including water purification, clean energy, food production, waste processing, and pharmaceutical development. Alfa Laval operates with core competencies in heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling, aiming to optimize customer processes with world-class technologies, systems, equipment, and services. The company fosters an environment that values drive, courage, and diversity, providing resources for employees to pursue and realize their ideas. Role Overview: Accountant Alfa Laval is seeking a full-time Accountant to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This role is central to maintaining accurate financial records and contributing to continuous improvements within the finance department. The Accountant will be responsible for verifying, allocating, posting, and reconciling various accounts, ensuring compliance with accounting principles and reporting schedules. Collaboration with finance counterparts, including personnel in the Finance Shared Service Center and Local Finance, is an integral part of this position. Key Responsibilities Ensure accurate domestic supplier reconciliations for E4. Manage intercompany invoicing for cost reallocation among domestic and foreign Alfa Laval companies. Submit monthly General Ledger (GL) reconciliations in line with timelines. Maintain and reconcile the GL (Suspense Account). Prepare and assist with the submission of VAT return files, and collate and file VAT documents for audit purposes. Prepare Withholding Tax (WH tax) files. Handle bank and cash postings and reconciliations, including bank recons and SL revaluations. Post Payroll, Leave, and Bonus journals on Scala. Prepare Concur transactions payments and post to Scala, checking and reconciling 101101 & 141000 GL. Prepare and post monthly accruals and interest on lease liability journals. Assist with year-end audit preparation files and respond to audit queries. Provide GL accounting support to the Finance Manager. Maintain (updates, interest, modifications) and reconcile IFRS 16 schedules. Manage company credit cards, including issuing, cancellations, and usage. Update Sales and Stock Modules after review. Update FTE statistics. Assist with onboarding new suppliers and update Scala with new supplier information. Coordinate with banks and external consultants (Tax & Assurance). Assist sales and service operation teams by providing required financial information. Process GOSI payments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is innovative, solutions-oriented, and driven, with a practical approach to executing tasks efficiently. This role requires a curious mindset, a commitment to continuous improvement, and strong interpersonal, team, and communication skills to deliver projects effectively. Adaptability and flexibility are also valued attributes. Why Join Alfa Laval? Alfa Laval offers a challenging position within an open and supportive environment focused on development and customer value. This role provides an opportunity to build a global network and learn from diverse nationalities. As part of a 140-year-old Swedish multinational company with stable growth, your work will contribute to Alfa Laval’s future success. The company's operations are guided by principles of sustainability and a commitment to people and the planet.

4bcdf49d2a4fff24.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز محور الطفل ضيافة الأطفال الأهلية عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريق العمل في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمشاركة في وضع الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج متقدمة ومبادرات إبداعية لضمان تحقيق ما يفوق توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق لتعزيز تجربة العملاء وضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة في الخدمات المقدمة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مركز محور الطفل ضيافة الأطفال الأهلية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مجال خدمة العملاء.

4bd9b079fd55930c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمكان الطبية عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، ويُعد فرصة للمتخصصين في مجال الهندسة الطبية للعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة ديناميكية. سيساهم شاغل الوظيفة في ضمان الأداء الأمثل للأجهزة الطبية وصيانتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج تركيب الأجهزة الطبية، بما في ذلك أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية لضمان الاستخدام الفعال والآمن. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية وكفاءتها. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. فهم عميق لتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية المختلفة. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في العمل. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة إمكان الطبية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في التطور المهني المستمر. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق إمكان الطبية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة التفاصيل المتعلقة بالدور.

4bc965902c88acf8.description: About the Role ECEC East Consulting Engineering Company is seeking a Design Manager Expert to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a professional with extensive experience in electrical engineering, particularly within the context of substation and transmission line projects. The role focuses on managing design processes and providing technical leadership. Key Responsibilities Oversee project management and supervision activities. Provide technical support for electrical substation and transmission line projects. Ensure project delivery meets quality standards and manage associated challenges, pressures, and risks. Maintain full knowledge of Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) standards and requirements. Apply expertise in technical specifications and electrical transmission codes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from a recognized university. Minimum of 15 years of experience in project management, supervision, and technical support. Demonstrated experience in the construction of electrical substations and transmission line projects. At least 10 years of experience in similar projects within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Valid membership with the Saudi Council of Engineers. Required Skills and Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. Excellent negotiation and conflict-resolution capabilities. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to significant engineering projects within the region. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

4b1566f8e577ec42.description: Location: Remote / Flexible Job Type: Entry-Level Placement Experience Required: No previous HR qualifications or experience required e-Careers is a dynamic and forward-thinking training company dedicated to changing lives through innovative training and career development solutions. Human Resources remain essential across every industry, creating opportunities for motivated individuals who want to build practical skills and begin a long-term professional career. e-Careers will provide you with the training to help you gain an CIPD qualification, then introduce you to a host company that will offer you a guaranteed remote internship placement. If successful, the host company may offer you a full-time paid role in Human Resources. Are you organised, people-focused, and interested in how businesses attract and support great talent? A growing number of employers are expanding their HR and Talent Acquisition teams, creating opportunities for individuals looking to begin a long-term career in this field. We are working alongside employers across multiple industries who are seeking motivated individuals ready to develop practical HR knowledge and step into entry-level opportunities. What the Traineeship Offers: CIPD qualification through an online, self-paced learning environment Full tutor support Guaranteed remote internship (part-time or full-time) 1 in 4 people offered a job from their host company after their internship Practical exposure to HR, recruitment support and workplace communication A career pathway into HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development or People Operations Every element of the programme (including the training and internship) is remote.
